newsitem.title: USA: APICS business outlook index fell to 53.0 in May.
newsitem.headline: APICS business outlook index fell to 53.0 in May.

text.p: The American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS) business outlook index fell to 53.0 in May from 53.4 in April, APICS said Thursday.
The current component index was almost unchanged at 52.8 versus 52.9 in April. The future component index slipped to 53.2 from 54.0.
A reading of 50 indicates neutral sentiment, APICS said.
"The overall index figure of 53.0 suggests that the manufacturing sector should be rising at about a 4.0 percent annual rate, not only in May but for the next three months as well," APICS said.
The APICS index is compiled monthly from a survey of manufacturing firms and is calculated by averaging respondents' ratings of current and future conditions.
Except for inventories and unfilled orders, all components of the index registered 50 or higher for the second month in row, APICS said.
